features.title: Dynamic Headlamp Auto-Leveling (Pitch & Acceleration Compensation)

F-150 Lightning.title: Dynamic Headlamp Auto-Leveling (Pitch & Acceleration Compensation)
F-150 Lightning.raw_community_title: Dynamic Headlamp Leveling (DHL)
F-150 Lightning.trim: Lariat / Platinum (Equipped with Onboard Scales & Suspension Height Sensors)
F-150 Lightning.source_sheet: Euro Kuga Mk3.5 / Ranger Platinum / Mustang S650 Comparison & Livnitup Master Database
F-150 Lightning.notes:
UNTESTED / EXPERIMENTAL: Enables Dynamic Headlamp Auto-Leveling (m2_DHL_Enable and m2_DHL_Mode = dynamic)
to automatically adjust vertical headlamp aim during acceleration, braking, and payload/towing squat.

IMPORTANT HARDWARE REQUIREMENT: Only for 2022 F-150 Lightnings equipped from the factory with front
and rear suspension ride-height sensors (Onboard Scales / Smart Hitch). Ford deleted physical suspension
height sensors on 2023+ Lightnings; enabling this on a truck without height sensors will trigger a missing
leveling sensor DTC. Because the Lightning's height sensors report via the VDM over CAN rather than direct
analog wiring to the HCM, m2_DHL_Input (734-01-02 xxxx xxx*) is set to 1 (CAN Input).

NOTE ON HCM CRC BITS: The HCM requires secondary CRC calculation bits (in addition to the standard
2-nibble checksum) and we do not currently have the offline calculation formula. Our working hypothesis
is that setting the CRC bits to all 0s (0000) or all 1s (1111) and then, without resetting or power-cycling
the module, immediately running the HCM headlamp calibration routine MIGHT trigger the module to generate
the correct CRC bits internally.

steps.notes:
HCM requires CRC bits: try setting CRC bits to 0000 or 1111 and running the calibration routine
without resetting the module to see if it generates valid CRC bits.

F-150 Lightning.notes:
UNTESTED / EXPERIMENTAL: Enables two camera-driven road sign lighting features used on European Ford
Matrix LED headlamps. (1) Sign-Based Light Mode (SBLM) uses the IPMA front camera to recognize
approaching junctions, roundabouts, yield, and stop signs and pre-widens the headlight beam into
the intersection. (2) Traffic Sign Deglare (TSDG) dims the specific Matrix high-beam LEDs shining
directly onto highly reflective road signs so they do not dazzle the driver when Glare-Free High
Beams are active. There is no separate APIM toggle specifically for TSDG (it operates automatically
whenever Glare-Free High Beams are switched on), but APIM 7D0-09-02 (Bit 3 of Nibble 9) is included

is that setting the CRC bits to all 0s (0000) or all 1s (1111) and then, without resetting or power-cycling
the module, immediately running the HCM headlamp calibration routine MIGHT trigger the module to generate
the correct CRC bits internally.

Note that HCM 734-05-01 xxxx xxx* also supports value 2 (SLME Traffic sign deglare ON) if testing against value 1 (SLME Enable).

recipes.title: Dynamic Headlamp Auto-Leveling (Pitch & Acceleration Compensation)
recipes.trim: Lariat / Platinum (Equipped with Onboard Scales & Suspension Height Sensors)
recipes.source_sheet: Euro Kuga Mk3.5 / Ranger Platinum / Mustang S650 Comparison & Livnitup Master Database
recipes.notes:
UNTESTED / EXPERIMENTAL: Enables Dynamic Headlamp Auto-Leveling (m2_DHL_Enable and m2_DHL_Mode = dynamic)
to automatically adjust vertical headlamp aim during acceleration, braking, and payload/towing squat.

IMPORTANT HARDWARE REQUIREMENT: Only for 2022 F-150 Lightnings equipped from the factory with front
and rear suspension ride-height sensors (Onboard Scales / Smart Hitch). Ford deleted physical suspension
height sensors on 2023+ Lightnings; enabling this on a truck without height sensors will trigger a missing
leveling sensor DTC. Because the Lightning's height sensors report via the VDM over CAN rather than direct
analog wiring to the HCM, m2_DHL_Input (734-01-02 xxxx xxx*) is set to 1 (CAN Input).

NOTE ON HCM CRC BITS: The HCM requires secondary CRC calculation bits (in addition to the standard
2-nibble checksum) and we do not currently have the offline calculation formula. Our working hypothesis
is that setting the CRC bits to all 0s (0000) or all 1s (1111) and then, without resetting or power-cycling
the module, immediately running the HCM headlamp calibration routine MIGHT trigger the module to generate
the correct CRC bits internally.

steps.notes:
HCM requires CRC bits: try setting CRC bits to 0000 or 1111 and running the calibration routine
without resetting the module to see if it generates valid CRC bits.

recipes.title: Predictive Curve Lighting (Map & Camera-Based Dynamic Bending)
recipes.raw_community_title: Predictive Curve Lighting (Adaptive Front Lighting System)
recipes.source_sheet: Euro Kuga Mk3.5 / Ranger 6G Matrix LED Comparison & Livnitup Master Database
recipes.notes:
UNTESTED / EXPERIMENTAL: Upgrades the Dynamic Bending Headlamps from reactive steering-wheel-only mode
(1) to anticipatory Map/Camera-Based Dynamic Bending (4), using the IPMA front lane-tracking
camera and SYNC 4 Navigation Electronic Horizon map stream to pre-steer the headlamp

standard 2-nibble checksum) and we do not currently have the offline calculation formula.
Our working hypothesis is that setting the CRC bits to all 0s (0000) or all 1s (1111) and then,
without resetting or power-cycling the module, immediately running the HCM headlamp calibration
routine MIGHT trigger the module to generate the correct CRC bits internally.

If North American map data triggers an HCM Electronic Horizon fault under mode 4, set
HCM 734-04-02 x*xx to 2 (Camera Based Dynamic Bending Enabled) instead.

steps.notes:
Set to 4 for Map/Camera Based Dynamic Bending (or 2 for Camera-Only Dynamic Bending).

recipes.title: Sign-Based Lighting & Traffic Sign Deglare (SBLM & TSDG)
recipes.raw_community_title: Sign-Based Light Mode & Traffic Sign Deglare
recipes.source_sheet: Euro Kuga Mk3.5 Matrix LED Comparison & Livnitup Master Database
recipes.notes:
UNTESTED / EXPERIMENTAL: Enables two camera-driven road sign lighting features used on European Ford
Matrix LED headlamps. (1) Sign-Based Light Mode (SBLM) uses the IPMA front camera to recognize
approaching junctions, roundabouts, yield, and stop signs and pre-widens the headlight beam into
the intersection. (2) Traffic Sign Deglare (TSDG) dims the specific Matrix high-beam LEDs shining
directly onto highly reflective road signs so they do not dazzle the driver when Glare-Free High
Beams are active. There is no separate APIM toggle specifically for TSDG (it operates automatically
whenever Glare-Free High Beams are switched on), but APIM 7D0-09-02 (Bit 3 of Nibble 9) is included
to enable the Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) toggle in SYNC 4 if not already enabled.

2-nibble checksum) and we do not currently have the offline calculation formula. Our working hypothesis
is that setting the CRC bits to all 0s (0000) or all 1s (1111) and then, without resetting or power-cycling
the module, immediately running the HCM headlamp calibration routine MIGHT trigger the module to generate
the correct CRC bits internally.

Note that HCM 734-05-01 xxxx xxx* also supports value 2 (SLME Traffic sign deglare ON) if testing against value 1 (SLME Enable).
